messages:
Alex P.: hey team :wave: i'm taking the primary for the EU overnight window (15:00 UTC -> 03:00 UTC). leaving a quick handoff note — tagging primary/secondary and any gaps i saw during day ops.

Maria G.: thanks Alex. are you good with the live routing runbook? anything we should flag for the night?

Alex P.: yep ran through it. main notes: one dedicated GPU pool (pool-eu-1) is at 78% utilization during peak bursts; autoscale configured but burst headroom is small. if we see sustained queue depth > 20 for 3 mins, follow the "scale-safeguard" step in the runbook.

Samir K.: can you paste the runbook link here? last time i had to escalate and i want the short commands.

Alex P.: sure — runbook (short):
- primary contact: @Alex P.
- secondary: @Maria G.
- pager groups: `pager-sre`, `pager-platform`
- escalation thresholds: P1 (service impacting) -> page SRE lead after 10m if not acknowledged; P0 (total outage) -> page SRE lead + Eng Director immediately.

Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall-handoff (quick snippet below)

```
# quick mitigation steps
1) check queue depth: `rcli metrics queue.depth --pool pool-eu-1`
2) if depth > 20: increase workers: `rcli scale pool-eu-1 --add 2`
3) fallback routing: toggle `route.lowcost=false` in routing config to switch to high-availability variants
4) if >50% error rate: open incident bridge and escalate
```

Jade L.: adding a couple clarifications we use internally:
- If customer-facing SLA is breached (error rate causing failed requests for >5% of users over 2 minutes), treat as P1 and page both `pager-sre` and `pager-platform`.
- If latency spikes but requests succeed, keep on primary queue and monitor for 10m before paging — use `latency.p95` as signal.

Alex P.: noted. also: i left a small coverage gap from 23:30-00:15 UTC where i'm on a call. Maria, can you be the warm backup for that stretch? i'll set my phone to vibrate just in case. :pray:

Maria G.: yep i can cover 23:30-00:15. will watch dashboards during that window. please add me to the incident bridge if you trigger one — i'll join asap.

IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Incident channel created: #incident-4987. Current severity: none. Bridging instructions and postmortem template added to the channel.

Samir K.: one more ask — what's our paging cadence for repeated pages? i.e., if pager-sre gets a page and there's no ack, what's next?

Jade L.: good Q. cadence we follow:
- first page: targeted (primary + secondary)
- 60s after unacked: repeat page to `pager-sre`
- 5m after unacked: escalate to SRE lead (pager -> phone)
- 15m after incomplete mitigation on P1: escalate to EngDirector + ProdSupport (phone + email)
- Always post a short status in the incident channel every 10 mins while unmitigated

Alex P.: adding practical notes: if you escalate to EngDirector, include the short TL;DR in the page body: what broke, user impact, mitigation attempted, next action. saves a call-back.

Maria G.: can someone paste the exact phone escalation list? I only have pager groups.

Jade L.: phone list (short): SRE Lead = +1-555-210-9001, Eng Director = +1-555-210-9002, Prod Support Pager Duty -> oncall rotation linked from the wiki. for privacy we keep the full rotation in the private doc.

Alex P.: final runbook pointer i use in emergencies: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/incident-escalation (has templates for pages and short status updates). when you create the bridge include the org tag `#ops-impact` to notify the right folks.

Samir K.: noted. if i'm stepping in, what's the handoff checklist?

Alex P.: quick handoff checklist (to paste into incident channel):
- who is primary/secondary (explicit)
- what services are impacted (short list)
- last successful change/deploy timestamp
- what mitigation steps tried and results
- current next action owner and ETA

Alex P.: i'll paste that into #incident-4987 when i open it. planning to do a warm handover at 23:15 UTC (10 minutes prior to my call).

Maria G.: perfect. one tiny operational tip: if you toggle fallback routing, watch cost alerts — we revert after 30m by default unless confirmed.

Alex P.: good call. setting reminder to reevaluate at 23:45 UTC if i had to toggle anything.

Oncall-Bot: reminder scheduled: `reevaluate-fallback` @Alex P. at 23:45 UTC.

Jade L.: thanks team. i'll update the runbook with the explicit cadence notes and the phone stub so new folks don't guess.

Alex P.: thanks all. will post a short follow-up after the warm handover. :thumbsup:

Maria G.: thanks Alex — enjoy the call window, will ping if anything pops up.

Samir K.: thanks — i'll keep an eye on the p95 and queue depth and jump in if alarms fire.
